title: Membership in the concentrating Fourier family
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $\\varepsilon\\in\\mathbb{R}$, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. Then $S$ belongs to the family concentrating the Fourier coefficients of $f$ in the $1$-norm if and only if $\\varepsilon\\le \\|\\widehat f\\|_1\\,|\\widehat f(S)|$, where $\\|\\widehat f\\|_1$ is the sum of the absolute values of all Fourier coefficients of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
